verdict.rationale: Stripe documents that it partners with the Visa and Mastercard networks so you can issue on either or both (docs-14), and that you can create a commercial or consumer card program without setup fees (docs-17). It also makes a marketing claim of going "from integration to live cards in minutes, not months" (docs-25). However, the pack never explicitly says that Stripe or its bank partners provide BIN sponsorship or handle compliance and program management. The time-to-first-card figure is a slogan rather than a documented timeline. Older community posts say access was invitation-only, which suggests onboarding could be gated (comm-4, comm-7). missing for 10: explicit BIN sponsorship/issuing-bank partner documentation, documented program-management/compliance responsibilities, a documented signup-to-live-card timeline beyond marketing copy, independent hands-on corroboration of onboarding speed.
